rules.statement: A wider and purposive construction must be preferred to a narrow and restrictive approach when determining an application for the addition of parties under section 18(1) of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: In determining an application for the addition of parties under section 18(1) of the Civil Procedure Code, a wider and purposive construction must be preferred to a narrow and restrictive approach.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 18 of the Civil Procedure Code
